mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.order_sn, o.coupon_id, o.integration, o.member_id, ot.id ot_id, ot.product_name ot_product_name, ot.product_sku_id ot_product_sku_id, ot.product_sku_code ot_product_sku_code, ot.product_quantity ot_product_quantity FROM oms_order o LEFT JOIN oms_order_item ot ON o.id = ot.order_id WHERE o.id = #{orderId}

SELECT o.id, o.order_sn, o.coupon_id, o.integration, o.member_id, o.use_integration, ot.id ot_id, ot.product_name ot_product_name, ot.product_sku_id ot_product_sku_id, ot.product_sku_code ot_product_sku_code, ot.product_quantity ot_product_quantity FROM oms_order o LEFT JOIN oms_order_item ot ON o.id = ot.order_id WHERE o.status = 0 AND o.create_time < date_add(NOW(), INTERVAL -#{minute} MINUTE) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oms_order_item t2 WHERE t2.order_id = o.id);

SELECT 'I1' AS code, '库存守恒' AS name, 1 AS hit_count, CONCAT('SKU ', s.id, ': lock_stock=', s.lock_stock, ' 但待付款订单侧应为=', IFNULL((SELECT SUM(oi.product_quantity) FROM oms_order_item oi JOIN oms_order o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE oi.product_sku_id = s.id AND o.status = 0 AND o.delete_status = 0), 0), ' (差异 ', s.lock_stock - IFNULL((SELECT SUM(oi.product_quantity) FROM oms_order_item oi JOIN oms_order o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE oi.product_sku_id = s.id AND o.status = 0 AND o.delete_status = 0), 0), ')' ) AS detail FROM pms_sku_stock s WHERE s.lock_stock <> IFNULL((SELECT SUM(oi.product_quantity) FROM oms_order_item oi JOIN oms_order o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE oi.product_sku_id = s.id AND o.status = 0 AND o.delete_status = 0), 0) ORDER BY s.id LIMIT 100

SELECT 'I2' AS code, '无负值' AS name, 1 AS hit_count, CONCAT('SKU ', id, ': stock=', stock, ', lock_stock=', lock_stock) AS detail FROM pms_sku_stock WHERE stock < 0 OR lock_stock < 0 ORDER BY id LIMIT 100

SELECT 'I3' AS code, '锁定不超总量' AS name, 1 AS hit_count, CONCAT('SKU ', id, ': lock_stock=', lock_stock, ' > stock=', stock, ' (超卖 ', lock_stock - stock, ' 件)') AS detail FROM pms_sku_stock WHERE lock_stock > stock ORDER BY (lock_stock - stock) DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT 'I4' AS code, '支付状态与时间一致' AS name, 1 AS hit_count, CONCAT('订单 ', id, '(', order_sn, ') status=', status, CASE WHEN status IN (1,2,3) AND payment_time IS NULL THEN ': 已付款却无支付时间' ELSE CONCAT(': 待付款却有支付时间=', IFNULL(DATE_FORMAT(payment_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'),'NULL')) END) AS detail FROM oms_order WHERE (status IN (1,2,3) AND payment_time IS NULL) OR (status = 0 AND payment_time IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT 'I5' AS code, '孤儿锁定' AS name, 1 AS hit_count, CONCAT('SKU ', s.id, ': lock_stock=', s.lock_stock, ' 但无任何待付款订单 (库存被永久占用 ', s.lock_stock, ' 件)') AS detail FROM pms_sku_stock s WHERE s.lock_stock > 0 AND IFNULL((SELECT SUM(oi.product_quantity) FROM oms_order_item oi JOIN oms_order o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE oi.product_sku_id = s.id AND o.status = 0 AND o.delete_status = 0), 0) = 0 ORDER BY s.lock_stock DESC LIMIT 100
